scope: Independent read-only mathematical source review; no new kernel run by this reviewer.
findings: nbranchTree_flatten is exact refinement through getTree_flatten under valid; the latter reduces to verified lookup/nth_error equality.
nentryTree_flatten is pointwise exact and allTree_flatten transfers universal checking over all entries, yielding ncheckTree_flatten.
ncheckTree_halts_iff invokes the existing normalized checker soundness theorem for every register store; no bounded execution premise is added.
Trailing-zero instruction pointers are handled by imported hn_ipeq. The normalized simulator consumes a real decrement transition before using induction.
normalized_tree_exact independently guards the untrusted buildTree fuel/truncation construction; normalized_tree_valid supplies the lookup invariant.
2851 actual lookups equals one initial lookup plus two for each of the1425 nonhalting entries. Halt-row target indices are unused.
32961 balanced-tree node visits versus2033059 list cells is a structural cost comparison, not a measured end-to-end speedup. The reported full concrete module time is slower than its baseline.
claim_boundary: No review of the entire inherited ZFC/consistency calibration was performed here.
